trust_decision.summary: Which role the subscriber apply worker (and so queued replicated SQL/DDL) runs as: decided by the pglogical.subscription_owner GUC, resolved in the supervisor and passed as the bgworker user; queued SQL is then run after SET ROLE to the queue tuple's role. This protection is ALREADY PRESENT at the pinned commit (the pinned commit is itself the 'Add a subscription_owner parameter' change); the listed fix commit is only a version bump.

landing_point.why: pglogical_execute_sql_command is where queued message payloads are parsed and executed on the subscriber with SET ROLE to the queued role.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: unknown: the listed fix contains no source change, so there is no route the fix left untouched to argue about.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Queued DDL/TRUNCATE must still replay as the provider-side role via SET ROLE (documented requirement that subscription_owner be a member of those roles); an empty subscription_owner must keep running as superuser.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: check_target_privileges is a hand-written ACL check for the low-level heap apply path; a planted copy that omits it on one action (e.g. TRUNCATE or a sync path) would be realistic.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The comment at pglogical_apply_heap.c:264-266 states the heap path bypasses executor permission checks, so each write route needs the explicit check and one could easily be missed.

O9_family: privilege management / code execution at elevated privilege via replicated SQL queue (CWE-89 label as published)

O10_build.toolchain: PGXS make against PostgreSQL server dev headers
O10_build.project_tests: pg_regress suite in sql/ and expected/ (e.g. expected/init.out); replication tests need two-node setup

j.j_sites_touched: none (fix.diff changes only Makefile, docs/README.md, expected/init.out, new extension SQL scripts, and the version macros in pglogical.h)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: n/a: the protection is already in the pinned tree
